title: pink debris helper
description: Changes the Ancient Debris texture to a bright pink color, making it incredibly easy to spot while mining in the Nether!
body:
# 🌸 Pink Ancient Debris  Better Visibility

This lightweight resource pack completely changes the look of Ancient Debris in the Nether. Instead of its default, dark brown texture, the block now features a vibrant, eye-catching pink color scheme with a distinct spiral pattern on top.

## ✨ Features

* **🎯 Maximum Visibility:** Never miss a block again! The bright pink color stands out perfectly in dark Nether caves and against lava flows.
* **⚡ 100% Performance Friendly:** Only modifies the Ancient Debris texture. Zero lag, no unnecessary files.
* **🕵️‍♂️ Legit Mining Booster:** Perfect for players who want to speed up their Netherite grind without relying on unfair X-Ray hacks or cheats.
